positions.name: MeridianGateRequirement
positions.frame: what does the Meridian deployment gate require and across which environments?
positions.why: Both segments express the same deployment gate decision for the Meridian release train: src-1 gives Quinton's first-person rationale (two unsigned artifacts reached staging) and the signed-manifest requirement; src-2 structures the decision into gate, scope (staging and production), and owner. Read together they answer what the gate demands and where it applies.
